name: Carry-select adder split
template: Split a wide ripple addition into fixed-width blocks, precompute each higher block for carry-in 0 and 1, and select on the incoming carry. Cuts the carry-chain depth from N bits to blocksize + a mux cascade. Same result, same latency.
guardrails: Keep block boundaries aligned to the operand width; cover every bit exactly once.
Do not add registers or change latency.
Do not alter the module ports or the clocked always block.

arithmetic_correctness_requirements.exact_fixed_width_equivalence: The rewritten arithmetic must produce exactly the same fixed-width result as the original expression for every legal operand value.
arithmetic_correctness_requirements.carry_out_preservation: For any N-bit sub-addition whose carry-out is consumed by another stage, compute that sub-addition with an intermediate width of at least N+1 bits and take carry-out from bit N. Never use bit N-1 of a truncated N-bit sum as carry-out.
arithmetic_correctness_requirements.carry_select_branch_width: For carry-select alternatives, both carry-in=0 and carry-in=1 computations must preserve the full N+1-bit intermediate whenever their carry-out is propagated. Select both the N-bit sum and the true carry-out according to the actual incoming carry.
arithmetic_correctness_requirements.intermediate_width_preservation: Do not truncate an arithmetic intermediate before any result bit or carry bit that is still needed downstream has been extracted.
arithmetic_correctness_requirements.signedness_preservation: Preserve the original signed/unsigned interpretation, operand extension behavior, result width, and modular overflow semantics.
arithmetic_correctness_requirements.split_width_is_not_fixed: The implementation may choose any legal split width or number of blocks. Correctness requirements are expressed in terms of each block width N and must hold for every chosen block.
